# Hearing Services of Delaware

> A comprehensive hearing care provider offering audiological evaluations, hearing aids, custom ear protection, and specialized hearing services across Delaware locations.

Hearing Services of Delaware is a full-service audiology practice featuring certified hearing care professionals, Oticon hearing aids, and specialized services including tinnitus treatment, industrial screening, and custom solutions for musicians and occupational safety.

## Key Topics

- Hearing aids
- Hearing assessments
- Audiologists
- Hearing loss
- Hearing aid fitting
- Custom earmolds
- Tinnitus treatment
- Diagnostic evaluations
- Hearing protection
- Oticon
- Real ear measurement
- Cerumen management
- Industrial screening
- Ear health
- Delaware locations

## Core Services

- [Home](https://www.heardelaware.com): Homepage featuring hearing aids and care services offered by Hearing Services of Delaware.
- [About Us](https://www.heardelaware.com/about-us): Company overview with locations in Dover, Middletown, and Newark.
- [Hearing Care and Hearing Aid Services](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services): Main services page covering assessments, fitting, and comprehensive hearing care.
- [Hearing Aids](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-aids): Hearing aids product page featuring IIC, CIC, and ITC styles.
- [Meet Our Hearing Care Experts](https://www.heardelaware.com/about-us/meet-our-hearing-care-experts): Staff directory featuring credentialed audiologists and hearing care professionals.
- [Testimonials](https://www.heardelaware.com/testimonials): Customer testimonials and patient reviews of hearing care services.

## Hearing Evaluations & Testing

- [Hearing Assessments](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/hearing-assessments): Guide to hearing assessment testing including pure-tone and speech testing.
- [Diagnostic Hearing Evaluations](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/diagnostic-hearing-evaluations): Information on diagnostic hearing evaluations and audiogram testing methods.
- [Real Ear Measurement](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/real-ear-measurement): Real ear measurement technology for hearing aid fitting verification.
- [Industrial Hearing Screening](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/industrial-hearing-screening): OSHA-compliant industrial hearing screening and occupational safety services.

## Hearing Aid Products & Fitting

- [Hearing Aid Dispensing and Fitting](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/hearing-aid-dispensing-and-fitting): Hearing aid dispensing and fitting services with device programming.
- [Oticon](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-aids/oticon): Oticon hearing aids including Oticon More with BrainHearing technology.
- [Guide to Hearing Aids](https://www.heardelaware.com/guide-to-hearing-aids): Downloadable consumer guide to hearing aids and hearing services.

## Specialized Hearing Solutions

- [Earmolds and Earplugs](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/earmolds-and-earplugs-for-hearing-protection): Custom earmolds and earplugs for hearing protection and noise exposure prevention.
- [Musician Ear Plugs and Monitors](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/musician-ear-plugs-and-monitors): Custom musician ear protection and in-ear monitor solutions.
- [Tinnitus Treatment](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/tinnitus-treatment): Tinnitus treatment using FDA-approved Levo System sound therapy.
- [Cerumen Management (Earwax Removal)](https://www.heardelaware.com/hearing-care-and-hearing-aid-services/cerumen-management-earwax-removal): Professional cerumen management and earwax removal for ear health.
